3293-5226-5721-8345.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
3293-5226-5721-8345.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-5226-5721-8345.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1671-2645-3430-4348.easyPrerequisites: Ley Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
1671-2645-3430-4348.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ley Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

725-4508-7786.easyPrerequisites:
Malcolm doesn't have summoning sickness.
Aura of Dominion and Hawkeye's Bow are both attached to Malcolm.
725-4508-7786.description:
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Malcolm.
Hawkeye's Bow triggers, causing Malcolm to deal 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage.
Resolve the Aura of Dominion ability, untapping Malcolm.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

147-4875-8200.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Grub's Command
147-4875-8200.description:
Cast Grub's Command by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Grub's Command, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Grub's Command, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-4875-8200.notes: When choosing modes, the other mode you choose will net additional results.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2033-3249-6073--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-3249-6073--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Angelic Sell-Sword triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3257-4050-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Rakdos Carnarium.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Rakdos Carnarium from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Repeat.

862-3652-6108-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
862-3652-6108-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1545-6824-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-6824-7690.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
1545-6824-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

3490-3641-4050-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-3641-4050-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

7173-7690-7743--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
7173-7690-7743--165.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

618-3581-4456-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {2}{R}
Kykar and Hematite Talisman trigger.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Resolve the Hematite Talisman trigger, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

225-1170-1671-7529.description:
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {1}{G}. 
Cast the copy of Rampant Growth from exile by paying {1}{G}, unpreparing Studious First-Year.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Studious First-Year, which enters prepared.
Resolve Rampant Growth, fetching a basic land from your library to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a brain counter on it
with a brain counter on it

3054-4050-7183.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
3054-4050-7183.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

2079-3259-7208.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-7208.description:
Declare Pestered Wellguard and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Faerie token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4659-6972-7160.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Arcbound Whelp.
When Arcbound Whelp dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Whelp's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Whelp from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

5921-5970-7014-7060.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of North Pole Patrol.
Activate one of the North Pole Patrol tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other North Pole Patrol token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2366-3322-3480-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3322-3480-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

955-3101-3292-3892.easyPrerequisites: You have an amount of {R} available equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin.
955-3101-3292-3892.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
955-3101-3292-3892.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

2178-4660-5676-6753.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Bloodshot Cyclops.
2178-4660-5676-6753.notablePrerequisites: Bloodshot Cyclops does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4660-5676-6753.description:
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing Reef Worm.
When Reef Worm dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Reef Worm trigger, creating two 3/3 Fish creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 1.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Fish.
When the Fish dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Fish trigger, creating two 6/6 Whale creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 6, dealing damage equal to the FIsh's power to any target.
Repeat from step 6 using the other Fish token.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Whale.
When the Whale dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Whale trigger, creating two 9/9 Kraken creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 12, dealing damage equal to the Whale's power to any target.
Repeat from step 12 for each other Whale token.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Kraken.
When the Kraken dies, Bloodshot Cyclops triggers, untapping Bloodshot Cyclops.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 18, dealing damage equal to the Kraken's power to any target.
Repeat from step 18 for each other Kraken token.

360-2530-2577-6518.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
360-2530-2577-6518.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Soul Warden, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Soul Warden and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

1069-5285-5295-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
1069-5285-5295-5499.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Angel.
Activate the Angel by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Angels.

1434-2136-6567.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Dragonhawk with haste.
When the Dragonhawk tokens enter the battlefield, they each trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling a number of cards from the top of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining trigger.
At the beginning of your end step, each Dragonhawk token triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent for each card exiled by the Dragonhawk tokens that were not played.
1434-2136-6567.notes: Assuming you control no other creatures with power 4 or greater, this combo can deal up to 60 damage to each opponent. This is reduced by 2 for each card you play that is exiled. For every additional creature you control with power 4 or greater, this combo deals up to an additional 10 damage per creature to each opponent.

1170-3363-5078-6259.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

1247-5832-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness and has at least one level counter on it.
1247-5832-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Joraga Treespeaker's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2743-4483-5517.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
Biovisionary has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2743-4483-5517.description:
Cast Echo Storm by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Echo Storm triggers, copying it for each time you've cast from the command zone this game, with each copy targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Echo Storms, creating that  make copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

955-2440-2703.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

2178-2921-5470.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ghired.
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
2178-2921-5470.description:
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the token dies, Ghired triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability,  putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

366-500-2557-4840.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Myr Battlesphere and creating four token copies of it with base power and toughness equal to half the original Myr Battlesphere's power and toughness, rounded up.
When the Myr Battlesphere tokens enter the battlefield, each token triggers once and Purphoros triggers four times.
Resolve each Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating a total of 32 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens, and triggering Purphoros 32 additional times.
Resolve all 36 Purphoros triggers, dealing 72 damage to each opponent.

1046-1479-4488.notablePrerequisites: You have a basic Forest in hand.
1046-1479-4488.description:
Play a basic Forest card from your hand.
Kodama and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Holding priority, activate the basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate Living Twister's second ability by paying {G}, returning the Forest from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting the Forest onto the battlefield from your hand.
When the Forest enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1819-2503-4651.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least ten creature cards in your graveyard.
Phyresis attached to Syr Konrad.
1819-2503-4651.description:
Cast Inverter of Truth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Inverter of Truth enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling your library and then shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card that left your graveyard this way, giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

2034-2281-3604.description:
Cast Saffi by paying {G}{W}.
When Saffi enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Saffi.
Activate the Saffi token by sacrificing it, targeting the nontoken Saffi.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Saffi, adding {C}{C}.
When the nontoken Saffi dies, the token Saffi triggers, returning the nontoken Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

185-1980-3098-4377.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} on each odd-numbered turn, with at most {3}{U} available each even-numbered turn
185-1980-3098-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Walk the Aeons.
Resolve both Walk the Aeonss, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast etiher Mystic Retrieval or Call to Mind by paying its mana cost, targeting either Call to Mind or Mystic Retrieval in your graveyard.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Call to Mind or Mystic Retrieval, targeting Walk the Aeons.
Resolve both Call to Minds or Mystic Retrievals, returning Walk the Aeons and either Call to Mind or Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

1560-1783-2290-2536.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least three.
You have less than two energy counters.
1560-1783-2290-2536.description:
Cast Greenbelt Rampager by paying 2 life.
Defiler of Vigor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain two life.
Greenbelt Rampager enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand and causing you to get {E}.
Activate Aetherwind Basker by paying {E}, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1322-3291-4499.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least four.
1322-3291-4499.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Karametra's Acolyte.
Repeat.

2493-3115-3557.description:
Cast Cyclonic Rift for its overload cost by paying {6}{U}, returning all nonland permanents you don't control to their owners' hands.
Deal combat damage using Brago, triggering its ability, blinking Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters, it triggers, returning Cyclonic Rift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
